0.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧⟦shared:1⟧Draw real annotations as independent layers, choose suitable shapes and share stacking positions between overlapping intervals and text.⟦shared:2⟧⟦shared:3⟧

3.translation: Use the first six pUC19 annotations to see how overlapping intervals share stacked positions. Source strand is retained.

6.translation:
⟦shared:0⟧ resolves overlapping annotation lanes. The label layer
uses the same Position, so text anchors follow those lanes. Prefer unique
⟦shared:1⟧ values for subset/reordered label inputs. The strict gene shortcut
requires known ⟦shared:2⟧; general features retain unknown/bidirectional semantics.

10.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧, ⟦shared:1⟧ | Directional coding/feature interval | Known direction is evidence, not a display guess |

11.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧, ⟦shared:1⟧ | Region or unfilled interval | Shape choice does not infer biological function |

12.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧, ⟦shared:1⟧, ⟦shared:2⟧ | Declared promoter/primer-style annotation | Computational matching and drawing are separate |

13.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧, ⟦shared:1⟧, ⟦shared:2⟧ | Custom interval/point-like emphasis | Keep real interval metadata; display shape is a mapping |

14.translation:
⟦shared:0⟧ and ⟦shared:1⟧ are useful presets, not aliases with
identical defaults. Use ⟦shared:2⟧ for signed offsets and
⟦shared:3⟧ as a circular placement preset; the latter is not a fourth
coordinate mode.

15.translation: ## Highlight an interval without rewriting observations ⟦shared:0⟧

18.translation:
The highlighted interval is the observed pUC19 replication origin. A region overlay uses its own table and ⟦shared:0⟧ scale. ⟦shared:1⟧
names sequences, ⟦shared:2⟧ supplies name/length in a single circle,
and ⟦shared:3⟧ marks cropped/segmented ends. ⟦shared:4⟧ is an
independent sequence-position reference bar for collinear plots; it differs from
⟦shared:5⟧, which controls genomic axes on sequences.
An ordinary ggplot2 annotation should use [position mapping](⟦shared:6⟧)
instead of treating bp as Cartesian x/y.

20.translation: Check intervals and strands before shapes and labels. Unknown strands remain in general features; stacking changes display placement, not genomic coordinates.

22.translation: Compare shouldered/flush/triangle arrows on one observed CDS in [arrow geometry](⟦shared:0⟧).

24.translation: Keep the original query ID and interval of the first observed HSP. Defaults are width 0.08, offset 0 and inside. Each subsequent figure changes only outside placement, width or offset. These are local geometry quantities, not bp. Set fixed fill in geom parameters or map categories to region_fill with its dedicated scale. Highlighting does not establish a new functional annotation.
